task: Unified deep-learning framework that ingests protein sequences, nucleic-acid sequences, and small-molecule structures and outputs 3D structures of biomolecular complexes via a diffusion architecture (AlphaFold-3-style).
named_methods: Coordinate-space diffusion (DDPM / score-based) for atomic positions
Symmetry-aware Hungarian matching for ligand RMSD
primary_outputs: Cα RMSD and ligand RMSD vs. 2L3R reference
fidelity_target: minimally faithful AF3-style diffusion module on a single complex (FKBP12 / FK506) with full evaluation pipeline; quantitative numbers are illustrative because AF3 weights / MSAs / GPU training are not available.
explicit_deviations: no triangular self-attention at full AF3 scale; replaced by lightweight pair attention
small CPU model trained / executed at toy scale on the single 2L3R complex
